title: A Saquon Barkley trade would create a $26 million cap charge in 2027

sources.name: Pro Football Talk
sources.title: A Saquon Barkley trade would create a $26 million cap charge in 2027
sources.description: With the Eagles' season quickly imploding and a potential reset coming in 2026, opportunities could arise over the next 23 days to trade running back Saquon Barkley.
